description: Resolve a taxon by name (e.g. "Tyrannosaurus") or integer taxon_no. The matched name, rank, parent, occurrence count and first/last appearance range describe taxon_no; accepted_no, accepted_name and accepted_rank identify PBDB's accepted taxon separately, and status carries its taxonomic opinion verbatim. Pass accepted_no as base_id to paleobiology_search_occurrences, paleobiology_get_diversity or paleobiology_search_collections for accepted-clade searches. Set show_children to page immediate child taxa with their own ranks and statuses.

children_offset.description: Number of immediate children to skip before the returned page — used only when show_children is true. Advance it by 200 while children_truncated is true to walk the whole child list.

name.description: Taxon name to resolve, e.g. "Tyrannosaurus" or "Ammonoidea". Provide this or taxon_no.

show_children.description: When true, include a page of the immediate child taxa of this taxon (at most 200 per call — children_truncated says whether more remain).

taxon_no.description: PBDB taxon id from a prior get_taxon, or accepted_no on an occurrence row. Provide this or name, never both.

name: paleobiology_get_taxon

accepted_name.description: PBDB accepted name (may differ from the searched name).

accepted_no.description: Accepted PBDB taxon id; pass as base_id to occurrence, diversity or collection searches.

accepted_rank.description: Rank of the accepted PBDB taxon.

attribution.description: CC-BY data attribution for the Paleobiology Database.

children.description: One page of immediate child taxa, at most 200 — present only when show_children was true. A taxon with more children than that returns a page, not the full list; read children_truncated before treating it as complete.

accepted_no.description: Accepted taxon id, distinct from the matched child id when redirected.

occurrence_count.description: Fossil occurrence count for the child, when reported.

status.description: PBDB taxonomic status verbatim; a nomen dubium is not a synonym.

synonym_of.description: Present when this child is a synonym; names the accepted taxon it folds into.

taxon_no.description: PBDB taxon id of the child — chain into paleobiology_get_taxon.

children_offset.description: Position in the child list this page started at (0 is the first child). Present only when show_children was true.

children_truncated.description: True when more immediate children remain past this page — re-call with children_offset advanced by 200 to read the next. False means this page runs to the end of the child list. Present only when show_children was true.

classification.description: Higher classification of the taxon. Each level is present only when PBDB resolves it; unspecified-rank sentinels are omitted at every level.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `taxon_not_found`: The name or taxon_no resolved to no PBDB taxon. `missing_selector`: Neither name nor taxon_no was provided. `conflicting_selector`: Both name and taxon_no were provided — the lookup takes exactly one selector. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

extant.description: True if the clade survives to the present day; false if entirely extinct.

first_appearance.description: A first- or last-appearance window. Empty when PBDB has no dated occurrences.

interval.description: Named geologic interval of this appearance, when known.

max_ma.description: Older bound of the appearance window (Ma).

min_ma.description: Younger bound of the appearance window (Ma).

last_appearance.description: A first- or last-appearance window. Empty when PBDB has no dated occurrences.

interval.description: Named geologic interval of this appearance, when known.

max_ma.description: Older bound of the appearance window (Ma).

min_ma.description: Younger bound of the appearance window (Ma).

notice.description: Guidance when the child list was cut off at the per-page cap (naming the children_offset that reaches the next page), or when children_offset ran past the end of the child list.

occurrence_count.description: Number of fossil occurrences recorded in PBDB, when reported.

parent_name.description: Name of the immediate parent taxon, when known.

parent_no.description: PBDB taxon id of the immediate parent, when known.

status.description: PBDB taxonomic status verbatim, when the name is not accepted.

taxon_no.description: Matched PBDB taxon id; the name, rank, parent, count and range describe this record. Use accepted_no for accepted-clade searches.

title: paleobiology-mcp-server: get taxon record and fossil range
